package.name: nros_interfaces
package.description: The ONE driver package for nano-ros' core pre-generated message set (RFC-0067 §D5, phase-465). Codegen emits the whole transitive closure of these four packages into `generated/<edition>/`, deduplicated — one crate per ament package, every dep a flat sibling. Four driver packages shipped `builtin_interfaces` three times; one ships it once.
